fusions.name: Nowhere to Flinch
fusions.desc: Thrusts a spike at a target up to 5 tiles away for 4 damage, rising to 1.3 times that at full reach. Its damage rises 10% per affliction on the target (max 30%).

fusions.name: Spiked Door Closing
fusions.desc: Spiked bars close in around you, dealing 28 damage that ignores armour to every enemy within 3 tiles and leaving each [Pinned] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Picket Line
fusions.desc: Drives a row of stakes 5 tiles long into the ground for 6 seconds. Anything that crosses it is left [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Bars Between Us
fusions.desc: Against enemies carrying your afflictions, your armour rises by 10%.
